name: Nib
text: Stand still, friend. You're worth two hundred either way.
spokenText: Stand still, friend. You're worth two hundred either way.

name: Merle
text: Let's finish before Delphine comes outside.
spokenText: Let's finish before Delphine comes outside.

name: Lurleen
text: You kept me waiting, sugar. Hold still a moment.
spokenText: You kept me waiting, sugar. Hold still a moment.

name: Bahadır
text: You took his coin! Now get past me!
spokenText: You took his coin! Now get past me!

name: Grukhar
text: Unpaid since spring. Now you want my letters too?
spokenText: Unpaid since spring. Now you want my letters too?

name: Femi
text: Keep your hands off me! These papers are mine!
spokenText: Keep your hands off me! These papers are mine!

name: Gorruk
text: In my own tent. You've got nerve, foundling.
spokenText: In my own tent. You've got nerve, foundling.

name: Mzee Kamau
text: Nine graves since that mine opened. Leave this grove.
spokenText: Nine graves since that mine opened. Leave this grove.

name: Wanjiru
text: You heard us. Stay out of the grove.
spokenText: You heard us. Stay out of the grove.

name: Olamide
text: Those ledgers stay here. So do you.
spokenText: Those ledgers stay here. So do you.

name: Adigun Adeyinka
text: Wait! Killing us won't stop my foster-son!
spokenText: Wait! Killing us won't stop my foster-son!

name: Bankole
text: Guards! Get them away from the records!
spokenText: Guards! Get them away from the records!

name: Idris
text: The Duke needs his rest. I can arrange yours.
spokenText: The Duke needs his rest. I can arrange yours.

name: Amara
text: Lower your sword. Don't make me stop you here.
spokenText: Lower your sword. Don't make me stop you here.

name: Rasheed
text: A bounty AND an invitation. What a generous evening.
spokenText: A bounty AND an invitation. What a generous evening.

name: Kemi
text: The invitations are worth more than you. Move, Rasheed.
spokenText: The invitations are worth more than you. Move, Rasheed.

name: Jelani
text: Cultists! Light the street. Leave the ward to me.
spokenText: Cultists! Light the street. Leave the ward to me.

name: Segun Marr
text: I signed your poster. This saves us a search.
spokenText: I signed your poster. This saves us a search.

name: Kolade Adeyinka
text: Come closer, brother. You've kept me waiting long enough.
spokenText: Come closer, brother. You've kept me waiting long enough.

name: Gbenga
text: Hold still. Your brother wants this done before breakfast.
spokenText: Hold still. Your brother wants this done before breakfast.

name: Gorruk
text: You again! No city to run to this time, foundling.
spokenText: You again! No city to run to this time, foundling.

name: Amara
text: I asked for his life. I haven't changed my mind.
spokenText: I asked for his life. I haven't changed my mind.

name: Kolade Adeyinka
text: Still standing, brother? Then come and finish it.
spokenText: Still standing, brother? Then come and finish it.

name: Hiwot
text: That wolf is watching us. The others are watching him.
spokenText: That wolf is watching us. The others are watching him.

name: Hiwot
text: His axe has teeth too. Keep away from the edge.
spokenText: His axe has teeth too. Keep away from the edge.

name: Hiwot
text: He is small. That staff is not.
spokenText: He is small. That staff is not.

name: Hiwot
text: Those bundles in her web are moving.
spokenText: Those bundles in her web are moving.

name: Hiwot
text: That is the mother. We are beneath her nest.
spokenText: That is the mother. We are beneath her nest.

name: Hiwot
text: He has a staff. Please tell me it is just a stick.
spokenText: He has a staff. Please tell me it is just a stick.

name: Hiwot
text: Do not touch the water around her feet.
spokenText: Do not touch the water around her feet.

name: Hiwot
text: He has already broken that shield. Look at his shoulder.
spokenText: He has already broken that shield. Look at his shoulder.

name: Hiwot
text: Three heads. I was rather hoping the third was a tail.
spokenText: Three heads. I was rather hoping the third was a tail.

name: Hiwot
text: That hammer has broken armour before. Look at the dents.
spokenText: That hammer has broken armour before. Look at the dents.

name: Desmond
text: That howl means he calling the whole family.
spokenText: That howl means he calling the whole family.

name: Desmond
text: That one laughs before he bites. Charming.
spokenText: That one laughs before he bites. Charming.

name: Desmond
text: Big crown, small fellow. Mind that staff, though.
spokenText: Big crown, small fellow. Mind that staff, though.

name: Desmond
text: Nobody touch that silk. I mean nobody.
spokenText: Nobody touch that silk. I mean nobody.

name: Desmond
text: Look up! Mother has come home angry.
spokenText: Look up! Mother has come home angry.

name: Desmond
text: That staff shining. This one knows more than smashing.
spokenText: That staff shining. This one knows more than smashing.

name: Desmond
text: No bargain with her. Keep your hands to yourself.
spokenText: No bargain with her. Keep your hands to yourself.

name: Desmond
text: That axe can split a door. Don't stand square.
spokenText: That axe can split a door. Don't stand square.

name: Desmond
text: Three mouths? Feeding him must cost a fortune.
spokenText: Three mouths? Feeding him must cost a fortune.

name: Desmond
text: Heavy hammer. Let him swing before you step in.
spokenText: Heavy hammer. Let him swing before you step in.

name: Winston
text: That's a very large argument for taking another road.
spokenText: That's a very large argument for taking another road.

name: Winston
text: I could've charged more for this road.
spokenText: I could've charged more for this road.

name: Winston
text: Lovely crown. Shame about the angry owner.
spokenText: Lovely crown. Shame about the angry owner.

name: Winston
text: Eight legs. Not one decent pocket.
spokenText: Eight legs. Not one decent pocket.

name: Winston
text: We are definitely not getting paid by the wing.
spokenText: We are definitely not getting paid by the wing.

name: Winston
text: He lives under the docks? Rent must be excellent.
spokenText: He lives under the docks? Rent must be excellent.

name: Winston
text: If she offers a discount, run.
spokenText: If she offers a discount, run.

name: Winston
text: Please let that axe be decorative. Ah. No.
spokenText: Please let that axe be decorative. Ah. No.

name: Winston
text: I'm counting three heads and exactly one bad idea.
spokenText: I'm counting three heads and exactly one bad idea.

name: Winston
text: Someone gave him a hammer bigger than my rent.
spokenText: Someone gave him a hammer bigger than my rent.

name: Santiago
text: Stay close. I'll keep those jaws off your flank.
spokenText: Stay close. I'll keep those jaws off your flank.

name: Santiago
text: That laugh carries. His pack will hear it.
spokenText: That laugh carries. His pack will hear it.

name: Santiago
text: Leave him room to surrender. Watch the staff.
spokenText: Leave him room to surrender. Watch the staff.

name: Santiago
text: Cut the hanging bundles down when she's beaten.
spokenText: Cut the hanging bundles down when she's beaten.

name: Santiago
text: Shields over your heads. I'll watch her claws.
spokenText: Shields over your heads. I'll watch her claws.

name: Santiago
text: The crystal's lit. Don't let him point it at you.
spokenText: The crystal's lit. Don't let him point it at you.

name: Santiago
text: Keep clear of her hands. I'll take the staff side.
spokenText: Keep clear of her hands. I'll take the staff side.

name: Santiago
text: He wants us frightened. Set your feet.
spokenText: He wants us frightened. Set your feet.

name: Santiago
text: I'll draw the left head. Watch the other two.
spokenText: I'll draw the left head. Watch the other two.

name: Santiago
text: Keep clear of that hammer. I'll keep him facing me.
spokenText: Keep clear of that hammer. I'll keep him facing me.

name: Beau
text: Th-that's the biggest wolf I've ever seen.
spokenText: Th-that's the biggest wolf I've ever seen.

name: Beau
text: I d-don't think he's laughing with us.
spokenText: I d-don't think he's laughing with us.

name: Beau
text: I can take the staff. I think. Y-yes.
spokenText: I can take the staff. I think. Y-yes.

name: Beau
text: D-don't look up. No, do look up!
spokenText: D-don't look up. No, do look up!

name: Beau
text: Th-those wings could carry a horse.
spokenText: Th-those wings could carry a horse.

name: Beau
text: He's b-bigger than the tunnel. How'd he get in?
spokenText: He's b-bigger than the tunnel. How'd he get in?

name: Beau
text: I d-don't like the way she knows we're here.
spokenText: I d-don't like the way she knows we're here.

name: Beau
text: R-right. Big axe. Bigger shield. Mine, I mean.
spokenText: R-right. Big axe. Bigger shield. Mine, I mean.

name: Beau
text: One, two... th-three. Of course there's three.
spokenText: One, two... th-three. Of course there's three.

name: Beau
text: Th-that hammer. Don't try to catch it on your blade.
spokenText: Th-that hammer. Don't try to catch it on your blade.

name: Delphine
text: Hold the line. Let the pack come to us.
spokenText: Hold the line. Let the pack come to us.

name: Delphine
text: Watch the backstroke. That axe reaches farther than his arms.
spokenText: Watch the backstroke. That axe reaches farther than his arms.

name: Delphine
text: A chief with a staff. Expect the others to rush.
spokenText: A chief with a staff. Expect the others to rush.

name: Delphine
text: Keep clear of the silk. Cut anyone loose immediately.
spokenText: Keep clear of the silk. Cut anyone loose immediately.

name: Delphine
text: She's guarding the cliff. Watch the shadow above you.
spokenText: She's guarding the cliff. Watch the shadow above you.

name: Delphine
text: A spellcaster in a narrow drain. Spread out.
spokenText: A spellcaster in a narrow drain. Spread out.

name: Delphine
text: Keep your boots out of that green water.
spokenText: Keep your boots out of that green water.

name: Delphine
text: He leads with his shoulder. Watch the axe behind it.
spokenText: He leads with his shoulder. Watch the axe behind it.

name: Delphine
text: Don't bunch up. Those heads cover different angles.
spokenText: Don't bunch up. Those heads cover different angles.

name: Delphine
text: He plants before he swings. Move when that foot stops.
spokenText: He plants before he swings. Move when that foot stops.

name: Itsuki
text: The pack has gone quiet. He's the one to watch.
spokenText: The pack has gone quiet. He's the one to watch.

name: Itsuki
text: He favours the right leg. Keep him turning.
spokenText: He favours the right leg. Keep him turning.

name: Itsuki
text: I'll watch his hands. You watch the staff.
spokenText: I'll watch his hands. You watch the staff.

name: Itsuki
text: I have the strand. Wait until her feet touch.
spokenText: I have the strand. Wait until her feet touch.

name: Itsuki
text: Wait for the wings to open. That's my shot.
spokenText: Wait for the wings to open. That's my shot.

name: Itsuki
text: I can see the crystal from here. Keep him facing you.
spokenText: I can see the crystal from here. Keep him facing you.

name: Itsuki
text: Her sleeve hides the free hand. Watch it.
spokenText: Her sleeve hides the free hand. Watch it.

name: Itsuki
text: There's a gap under his raised arm.
spokenText: There's a gap under his raised arm.

name: Itsuki
text: The outer heads turn first. I have the right.
spokenText: The outer heads turn first. I have the right.

name: Itsuki
text: The hammer leaves his shoulder open. I can reach that.
spokenText: The hammer leaves his shoulder open. I can reach that.

name: Bahadır
text: Vallahi! That is a wolf worth singing about!
spokenText: Vallahi! That is a wolf worth singing about!

name: Bahadır
text: He laughs? GOOD! Let us give him something to remember!
spokenText: He laughs? GOOD! Let us give him something to remember!

name: Bahadır
text: Little king! Put down that great stick!
spokenText: Little king! Put down that great stick!

name: Bahadır
text: Eight legs, Fındık! We shall count them afterward!
spokenText: Eight legs, Findik! We shall count them afterward!

name: Bahadır
text: HA! Mother comes to scold us herself!
spokenText: HA! Mother comes to scold us herself!

name: Bahadır
text: Big fellow! Come where I can see both your hands!
spokenText: Big fellow! Come where I can see both your hands!

name: Bahadır
text: No witch is touching my friends. Back, old woman!
spokenText: No witch is touching my friends. Back, old woman!

name: Bahadır
text: A fine axe! Show me if you can lift it!
spokenText: A fine axe! Show me if you can lift it!

name: Bahadır
text: Three heads! At last, one to hear EACH warning!
spokenText: Three heads! At last, one to hear EACH warning!

name: Bahadır
text: HA! A proper hammer! Come, let us hear it ring!
spokenText: HA! A proper hammer! Come, let us hear it ring!

name: Yasemin
text: Do not answer that howl. Let him wonder.
spokenText: Do not answer that howl. Let him wonder.

name: Yasemin
text: Hear how the pack waits for his laugh to end.
spokenText: Hear how the pack waits for his laugh to end.

name: Yasemin
text: That staff has been used often. See the scorched grip.
spokenText: That staff has been used often. See the scorched grip.

name: Yasemin
text: Do not brush the silk from your coat with bare hands.
spokenText: Do not brush the silk from your coat with bare hands.

name: Yasemin
text: She has young nearby. That makes her more dangerous.
spokenText: She has young nearby. That makes her more dangerous.

name: Yasemin
text: That blue stone is awake. Stay away from its light.
spokenText: That blue stone is awake. Stay away from its light.

name: Yasemin
text: There is sickness in her hands. Do not let her touch you.
spokenText: There is sickness in her hands. Do not let her touch you.

name: Yasemin
text: His fury is loud. Watch the quieter hand.
spokenText: His fury is loud. Watch the quieter hand.

name: Yasemin
text: One body tires. Three heads do not change that.
spokenText: One body tires. Three heads do not change that.

name: Yasemin
text: Watch his grip. He is waiting for you to come closer.
spokenText: Watch his grip. He is waiting for you to come closer.

name: Devendra
text: A large throat. Keep clear while I find my aim.
spokenText: A large throat. Keep clear while I find my aim.

name: Devendra
text: Mind the fur. Fire travels quickly through it.
spokenText: Mind the fur. Fire travels quickly through it.

name: Devendra
text: That crystal has a fracture. I can work with that.
spokenText: That crystal has a fracture. I can work with that.

name: Devendra
text: Keep the silk off me. I will clear a path.
spokenText: Keep the silk off me. I will clear a path.

name: Devendra
text: Do not crowd me. I need room to cast upward.
spokenText: Do not crowd me. I need room to cast upward.

name: Devendra
text: A cave and an angry mage. Mind the ceiling.
spokenText: A cave and an angry mage. Mind the ceiling.

name: Devendra
text: Do not inhale that vapour. Cover your mouths.
spokenText: Do not inhale that vapour. Cover your mouths.

name: Devendra
text: Draw his axe aside. Leave me a clear line.
spokenText: Draw his axe aside. Leave me a clear line.

name: Devendra
text: Keep the heads apart. I need a clear centre.
spokenText: Keep the heads apart. I need a clear centre.

name: Devendra
text: Keep his hammer away from me. I need both hands.
spokenText: Keep his hammer away from me. I need both hands.

name: Layla
text: Such a deep voice. Pity about the breath.
spokenText: Such a deep voice. Pity about the breath.

name: Layla
text: That laugh needs work. Preferably from farther away.
spokenText: That laugh needs work. Preferably from farther away.

name: Layla
text: All that ceremony for such a little throne.
spokenText: All that ceremony for such a little throne.

name: Layla
text: Silk everywhere, and not a single flattering drape.
spokenText: Silk everywhere, and not a single flattering drape.

name: Layla
text: She knows how to make an entrance. Mind the talons.
spokenText: She knows how to make an entrance. Mind the talons.

name: Layla
text: Please keep him over there. Especially when he opens his mouth.
spokenText: Please keep him over there. Especially when he opens his mouth.

name: Layla
text: Darling, I wouldn't touch her hand with a borrowed glove.
spokenText: Darling, I wouldn't touch her hand with a borrowed glove.

name: Layla
text: So much muscle. Such an unpromising temper.
spokenText: So much muscle. Such an unpromising temper.

name: Layla
text: Three admirers at once. How inconvenient.
spokenText: Three admirers at once. How inconvenient.

name: Layla
text: Such a heavy entrance. I hope he tires quickly.
spokenText: Such a heavy entrance. I hope he tires quickly.

name: Kaito
text: Nice entrance. Shame he's here to eat us.
spokenText: Nice entrance. Shame he's here to eat us.

name: Kaito
text: I'd laugh too, carrying an axe that size.
spokenText: I'd laugh too, carrying an axe that size.

name: Kaito
text: I like the crown. I'll shoot around it.
spokenText: I like the crown. I'll shoot around it.

name: Kaito
text: I usually prefer admirers with fewer eyes.
spokenText: I usually prefer admirers with fewer eyes.

name: Kaito
text: Great wings. Terrible place to stand beneath them.
spokenText: Great wings. Terrible place to stand beneath them.

name: Kaito
text: He brought a staff. I'll aim for the fingers.
spokenText: He brought a staff. I'll aim for the fingers.

name: Kaito
text: Keep her looking at you. I've got the crooked wrist.
spokenText: Keep her looking at you. I've got the crooked wrist.

name: Kaito
text: I'm not getting within flirting distance of that axe.
spokenText: I'm not getting within flirting distance of that axe.

name: Kaito
text: One arrow each? No, let's start with the loud one.
spokenText: One arrow each? No, let's start with the loud one.

name: Kaito
text: Nice hammer. I'll admire it from back here.
spokenText: Nice hammer. I'll admire it from back here.

name: Wanjiru
text: He is warning his pack. Give him no opening.
spokenText: He is warning his pack. Give him no opening.

name: Wanjiru
text: Hear that? The little ones are waiting for his signal.
spokenText: Hear that? The little ones are waiting for his signal.

name: Wanjiru
text: He stamps that staff like he owns the ground.
spokenText: He stamps that staff like he owns the ground.

name: Wanjiru
text: She feels the web through her feet. Step lightly.
spokenText: She feels the web through her feet. Step lightly.

name: Wanjiru
text: She smells us near her nest. Watch the tail.
spokenText: She smells us near her nest. Watch the tail.

name: Wanjiru
text: He has fouled this water enough. Sawa. Move him.
spokenText: He has fouled this water enough. Sawa. Move him.

name: Wanjiru
text: The mud is sick around her. Keep your skin clear.
spokenText: The mud is sick around her. Keep your skin clear.

name: Wanjiru
text: All that iron. I want him away from the trees.
spokenText: All that iron. I want him away from the trees.

name: Wanjiru
text: Three hungry heads. Watch the body when they turn.
spokenText: Three hungry heads. Watch the body when they turn.

name: Wanjiru
text: Let the hammer fall. Then move in before he lifts it.
spokenText: Let the hammer fall. Then move in before he lifts it.

name: Dai Morgan
text: That's a whole winter coat with teeth, that is.
spokenText: That's a whole winter coat with teeth, that is.

name: Dai Morgan
text: Heavy axe, thin haft. I know where I'm aiming.
spokenText: Heavy axe, thin haft. I know where I'm aiming.

name: Dai Morgan
text: That staff's taller than he is. Mind the swing.
spokenText: That staff's taller than he is. Mind the swing.

name: Dai Morgan
text: I did not leave a mine to get wrapped in silk.
spokenText: I did not leave a mine to get wrapped in silk.

name: Dai Morgan
text: Lovely. A roof that bites back.
spokenText: Lovely. A roof that bites back.

name: Dai Morgan
text: Look at that staff. Better stone than his manners deserve.
spokenText: Look at that staff. Better stone than his manners deserve.

name: Dai Morgan
text: Keep that muck off your cuts. It'll fester.
spokenText: Keep that muck off your cuts. It'll fester.

name: Dai Morgan
text: Good iron, bad temper. Familiar combination.
spokenText: Good iron, bad temper. Familiar combination.

name: Dai Morgan
text: Three heads and one neck ache waiting to happen.
spokenText: Three heads and one neck ache waiting to happen.

name: Dai Morgan
text: That head needs a new haft. I'll help it along.
spokenText: That head needs a new haft. I'll help it along.

name: Amara
text: Let him come to us. Keep your blade low.
spokenText: Let him come to us. Keep your blade low.

name: Amara
text: The laugh is a distraction. Watch his hands.
spokenText: The laugh is a distraction. Watch his hands.

name: Amara
text: Small reach. Long staff. Do not confuse the two.
spokenText: Small reach. Long staff. Do not confuse the two.

name: Amara
text: Keep your arms free. I'll cut the silk.
spokenText: Keep your arms free. I'll cut the silk.

name: Amara
text: When she lands, move away from the tail.
spokenText: When she lands, move away from the tail.

name: Amara
text: The staff first. I don't want that spell behind us.
spokenText: The staff first. I don't want that spell behind us.

name: Amara
text: Do not let her close her hand around you.
spokenText: Do not let her close her hand around you.

name: Amara
text: Let him commit to the swing. Then step inside.
spokenText: Let him commit to the swing. Then step inside.

name: Amara
text: Make one head turn. The others will have to follow.
spokenText: Make one head turn. The others will have to follow.

name: Amara
text: Give that hammer room. He cannot change its path quickly.
spokenText: Give that hammer room. He cannot change its path quickly.
